name: Microsoft HTML Slide Creation Kit Assets
purpose: Compact, web-native icon assets with deterministic AI lookup.

collections.useFor: Generic UI actions, status, navigation, objects, and concepts.
Azure products, services, and architecture diagrams.

rendering.fluentSvg: Inline SVG content to inherit CSS currentColor, or use the file as a CSS mask.
rendering.fluentFont: Load the included CSS, then use its icon-ic_fluent_* class names.
rendering.azureSvg: Use as an img source or inline SVG; preserve official colors and proportions.

included: One canonical Regular and Filled SVG per available Fluent icon concept.
One Resizable Fluent WOFF2 font, CSS class map, and JSON glyph map.
All Azure V24 SVGs with their category hierarchy, terms, and FAQ.
Searchable per-collection JSON catalogs and required Fluent legal files.
excluded: Deprecated Fluent color icons and less-common Light variants.
Duplicate TTF and WOFF font formats, HTML previews, and separate style fonts.
React, React Native, Android, iOS, Flutter, PDF icon exports, and build tooling.
